name: medical-top-tier-capability-stack
label_zh: 顶级医学诊断分析循证治疗护理能力栈
capability_target: Broad top-tier-hospital-style decision-support capability across diagnosis, multimodal report/image interpretation, evidence synthesis, medication safety, treatment-plan design, nursing, genetics and specialty knowledge. This is a capability target, not a claim that software equals an in-person tertiary hospital.
capabilities: CT MRI PET X-ray ultrasound and DICOM series ingestion and analysis support
pathology report and whole-slide image support
medication identification normalization labeling contraindication interaction and adverse-effect analysis
pregnancy lactation renal hepatic and pharmacogenomic medication context
treatment-option comparison and individualized treatment-plan design support
nursing assessment monitoring self-care rehabilitation and follow-up support
genetic and genomic test interpretation support
precision oncology and actionable-variant evidence support
medical terminology normalization and cross-vocabulary mapping
